'''Bael'dun Keep''' is the fortress<ref>[[Bael'dun Fortress Schematics]]</ref> that overlooks the [[Bael Modan]] digsite in the [[southern Barrens]]. It is inhabited by a force of [[Dwarf|dwarves]] that are hostile to [[Horde]] players. [[Gann Stonespire]] and [[Feegly the Exiled]] give out quests to raid the stronghold, which is ruled by the cunning [[General Twinbraid]].
